# AiShort — Brand Mark Specification

**AiShort** / AiShort

Generated by `mark-to-spec`. All values are derived from the approved abstract motif; do not hand-edit without updating the source config.

## 1. Deliverables

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `mark.svg` | Full-color master vector |
| `mark-mono.svg` | Single-color version for foil, engraving, one-color print |
| `mark-reverse.svg` | Reversed white version for dark backgrounds |
| `safe-zone.svg` | Clear-space diagram |
| `scale-test.png` | 16/24/32/48/64 px monochrome legibility test |
| `application-preview.png` | Six-scenario application board |

## 2. Color specification

| Role | 角色 | HEX | RGB | CMYK | HSL | vs Panel | vs White | Usage |
|------|------|-----|-----|------|-----|----------|----------|-------|
| Primary | 主色 | `#3EB489` | RGB(62, 180, 137) | C66 M0 Y24 K29 | H158 S49% L47% | 2.28:1 | 2.59:1 | 主标记族的填充，占面积最大 |
| Structural | 深色结构色 | `#43474A` | RGB(67, 71, 74) | C9 M4 Y0 K71 | H206 S5% L28% | 8.24:1 | 9.38:1 | 轮廓、骨架、单色版与文字 |
| Accent | 点缀色 | `#D2D6D8` | RGB(210, 214, 216) | C3 M1 Y0 K15 | H200 S7% L84% | 1.28:1 | 1.46:1 | 焦点强调，面积不超过 8% |
| Panel | 象牙底 | `#F3F0E8` | RGB(243, 240, 232) | C0 M1 Y5 K5 | H44 S31% L93% | 1.00:1 | 1.14:1 | 编辑作品抽象面板背景 |

**Color discipline**: 1 primary + 1 dark structural + at most 1 accent, all extracted from the reference visual. No new hue may be introduced.

## 3. Clear space and minimum size

- **Clear space (X)** = 11.00 units on a 100-unit canvas (= 11.0% of the mark width). Keep this area free of any other element.
- **Minimum size**: 16 px (screen) / 12 mm (print). Below this, use the simplified variant.
- **Safe zone diagram**: `safe-zone.svg`

## 4. Variants

| Variant | File | When to use |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Full color | `mark.svg` | Default, on light backgrounds |
| Single color | `mark-mono.svg` | Foil stamping, engraving, screen printing, fax, one-color print |
| Reversed | `mark-reverse.svg` | Dark or colored backgrounds |

## 5. Monochrome legibility diagnosis

- Distinct tones after monochrome conversion: **1**
- Luminance spread: 0.0000
- Verdict: **PASS - shape carries the hierarchy**

## 6. Misuse (prohibited)

- Do not recolor the mark with colors outside the specified palette.
- Do not stretch, condense, rotate, or apply perspective distortion.
- Do not add gradients, drop shadows, glows, or outlines.
- Do not place the mark on a busy background without the reversed variant or a solid panel behind it.
- Do not reduce below the minimum size or inside the clear space.
- Do not reassemble the primitives into a new composition.

## 8. Notes

Derived from AiShort original logo (static/img/logo.png). High facts: F1 closed contour split by vertical axis, left half solid / right half linear; F2 dominant vertical axis; F3 palette teal #3EB489 + dark structural #43474A + neutral; F4 node-to-mark scale ratio 1:8. Circuit routing (F6) reduced from 6-8 right-angle nodes to one straight round-capped segment: the two end caps are the nodes, the straight path is the shortcut, and everything deleted between them is the shortcut. Gradient (F7) discarded. Revision 2: node pair plus connector collapsed from 3 primitives into 1 round-capped line to survive 16px; ring stroke raised 8->10, solid half radius 29->26 to widen the mid-seam.
